name: Vova Matjuhin
source:
A ten-year-old green-eyed boy with cropped brown hair and protruding ears.

In the photo, Vova is dressed in a school uniform, which includes a white shirt and vest. The notice of his disappearance mentions that on the day of his disappearance, Vova was wearing an orange hooded jacket, a knitted black hat, a scarf and gray mittens with green stripes.
